description: Browse Langfuse LLM traces, spans and scores from a sidebar.
welcome.disconnected:
Connect to Langfuse to browse your agent traces.
[Set API Keys](command:langfuse.setKeys)
Keys come from Langfuse → Settings → API Keys. The secret key is stored in the OS keychain.
welcome.connected:
No traces match the current view.
[Refresh](command:langfuse.refresh)
[Filter Traces](command:langfuse.setFilter)
configuration.host: Base URL of your Langfuse instance (Cloud US: https://us.cloud.langfuse.com, Cloud EU: https://cloud.langfuse.com, or your self-hosted URL).
configuration.publicKey: Langfuse public key (pk-lf-…). The matching secret key is stored securely in the OS keychain via the 'Set API Keys' command.
configuration.traceLimit: How many recent traces to load in the sidebar.
configuration.autoRefreshSeconds: Automatically refresh the traces list every N seconds. 0 disables auto-refresh.
